title: Spot the undefined behaviour
description:
Fix five small functions that have undefined behaviour, and explain each fix in a comment.

```
average(INT_MAX, INT_MAX) = 2147483647
shift_left(1, 31) = 2147483648
last_char("") = none
copy fits: "hello"
first element of an empty array: none
```
hints: `a + (b - a) / 2` avoids overflow when both have the same sign; a cast to `long long` works for any pair (lesson 6.02).
For `last_char`, return a value like `-1` for "none" when `strlen(s) == 0`.
requirements: `int average(int a, int b)` must not overflow.
`uint32_t shift_left(uint32_t v, unsigned n)` must not shift by 32 or more, and must shift unsigned values.
`int last_char(const char *s)` must not read before the string; `copy` must not write past the buffer; `first` must not read an empty array.
Compile with warnings on and check with the address sanitizer if your setup has it.
stretch: Run each broken version with `-fsanitize=undefined,address` and read what the sanitizer reports.
